title: Eight Sleep reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its content in and lifts it 18px (or any distance) as it scrolls into view, over a fixed 220px of scroll; steps stagger it by 40px each. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation; static HTML shows everything.
notes: browsers without animation-timeline, and reduced motion, show the content in place
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box: use overflow-clip, or the timeline freezes
